conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Exactly, it often comes down to the quality and relevance of your efforts rather than simply how much you did.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: So, how do you define "relevance" in that context?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Relevance often refers to how well an activity aligns with your overarching goals or values, contributing meaningfully to what you want to achieve.
